scientific_design.comparison_rule: Direct performance comparisons among native SPA-Net, SPA-Net+ParT, and SPA-Net+JP-JEPA must use identical Track-A splits, labels, weighting, heads, and evaluation code. Track-B results are external response/stability studies unless a validated representation bridge and compatible labels exist.
scientific_design.core_hypothesis: Jet representations pretrained with ParT or JP-JEPA may improve SPA-Net assignment/classification performance and robustness relative to native jet features, with JP-JEPA expected to be especially informative for sample efficiency and domain shift.
